title: SF4200 (2025-2026 Regular): Reenact the 2024 amendment to the definition of trigger activator

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (1st Engrossment, 2026-03-18; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/SF/4200/versions/1/)
provenance.note: 1st engrossment, 2026-03-18. The section heading names it a 'ban on binary triggers'; the bill itself only cites the 2024 law and does not restate its words. Amendments made after the version read are not in the text read (no passage vote recorded).

operative_text: Section 1: Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 36, section 2, is reenacted retroactively and without interruption from January 1, 2025.
